sources.entry: agnix by agent-sh - The linter and LSP for AI coding assistants — validates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks, and MCP config, with autofixes and IDE plugins.

summary.one_liner: agnix is a Rust-based linter and language server that validates agent configuration files such as CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, hooks, and MCP configs across many AI coding tools.
summary.what_it_does: Validates agent config files against 757 rules across Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, Gemini CLI, Cline, and other tools, reporting errors and warnings with file, line, and rule ID. It can apply fixes automatically, with safe, unsafe, and dry-run modes, and explain individual rules via the explain command. It offers a CLI (runnable via npx, pip, Homebrew, or Cargo), an LSP server for editors (VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, Zed), an MCP server, and a GitHub Action. Tool-specific filtering is available with a --target flag, and output can be formatted for GitHub Actions annotations. A browser playground is mentioned for pasting configs without installing.
use_cases: check agent hooks and MCP server configs
run agent config validation in CI with GitHub Actions
get inline editor diagnostics for agent configs
notable: Covers many AI coding tools' config formats (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, Gemini CLI, and more) in one linter
Auto-fix with safe, unsafe, and dry-run diff preview modes
Ships as a CLI, LSP language server, MCP server, WASM bindings, and GitHub Action
Rule explain command gives rationale and evidence for each rule ID
Rust workspace split into rules, core engine, CLI, LSP, MCP, and WASM crates
caveats: Support tiers vary: some tools (Continue, Aider, Amazon Q, Tabnine, Codeium, Windsurf/Devin, Amp) are outside active support, and Muse Code and Kimi Code validation is still pending
Roo Code support was removed in version 0.59.0
Contributor workflow is heavy: preflight scripts, full checks require Clippy, tests, and hosted CI gates
keywords: validate ai assistant files in ci
